title: Strengthen Big Beat score skill against repetitive arrangements
description: Revise the Big Beat score-writing skill so it reliably produces varied drum-kit architectures, section-specific patterns, and distinct hook/form choices instead of repeating the same chopped-sample template.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Structuring anti-repetition rules, 16/24/32-bar form dynamics, tease-and-reveal hook expansions, and bass-lock guidelines to prevent formulaic Big Beat arrangements.

right_now_summary: The Big Beat skill is being revised to create more varied rhythms, hooks, bass lines, and song forms.
